text: This is to advise that the report Residential On-Street Electric Vehicle Charging Stations - Parking Amendments – Non-Delegated Locations will be on the agenda of the Toronto and East York Community Council meeting on January 16th, 2017. In November, City Council endorsed a Residential On-Street Electric Vehicle Charging program. The purpose of this report is to provide the necessary parking by-law amendments required to support the installation of these spaces. Transportation Services is still in the process of finalizing the by-law amendments to be proposed by this report.
Item TE29.44 was withdrawn from the Agenda.
